True def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0]) if height else 0
    for r in range(1, height - 1):
        if all(v == 0 for v in grid[r]) and any(v == 2 for v in grid[r - 1]) and any(v == 2 for v in grid[r + 1]):
            out[r] = [3] * width
            break
    return out
